units.source_text: 有一回，发长彦跟平时一样坐在大树下面，怡然自得的吹着笛子。

en.t: One day, Kaminagahiko sat beneath a great tree as usual, contentedly playing his flute.

units.source_text: 突然，一个身材高大的独脚男子出现在他眼前，

en.t: Suddenly, a tall one-legged man appeared before his eyes,

units.source_text: 男子身上佩戴着许多碧玉，看着他说：“你的笛声真优美啊！

en.t: The man wore many pieces of jasper on his body, looked at him, and said, "The sound of your flute is truly beautiful!

units.source_text: 很久很久以前，我就独自住在深山的一个洞穴里，

en.t: Long, long ago, I lived alone in a cave deep in the mountains,

units.source_text: 成天梦见神话时代时候的事儿，

en.t: spending my days dreaming of things from the age of myth,

units.source_text: 自从你到这边砍柴吹笛之后，

en.t: but ever since you began coming here to cut firewood and play your flute,

units.source_text: 我就沉醉其中了，每天都听的饶有兴趣，很是欢愉。

en.t: I became entranced by it; every day I listened with great interest and deep delight.

units.source_text: 所以我今天专门现身此地对你表示感谢。

en.t: That is why I have deliberately appeared here today to thank you.

units.source_text: 你有什么想要的东西，我可以帮你实现。”

en.t: If there is anything you want, I can make it come true for you."
